newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIAN LEV CLOSES FLAT NEAR 234 PER DOLLAR.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIAN LEV CLOSES FLAT NEAR 234 PER DOLLAR.

text.p: Dollar sales by Bulgaria's central bank and a major commercial bank offset a rise in foregn currency demand on the local interbank market where the lev closed flat on opening near 234 per dollar, dealers said.

"(Foreign currency) demand picked up in early afternoon trade, pressuring the lev to 234.40/235, but supply quickly rose and the lev rebounded to 233.80/234.20 opening levels where it closed," said a dealer.
Dealers said the central bank sold dollars at 234.00/30 levs in the morning and was later joined by Bulbank, which sold foreign currency at 234.10/13.
Central bank officials were not immediately available for comment.
According to traders foreign currency demand today came mainly from a large final client, probably an energy importer.
Dollar demand rose also on the local cash market where the lev fell to 239-240 per dollar from 236 on Thursday, dealers said. -- Anastas Petrov, Sofia Newsroom, 359-2-84561
